summary.text: Kiel Reid is the Democratic candidate for the Michigan House of Representatives, District 88, in the November 3, 2026 general election, after advancing from the August 4 Democratic primary.
A small business owner who lives in Norton Shores, he says he is running on affordability and health care costs.

paragraphs.text: In a Ballotpedia survey, Reid described himself as a small business owner, community builder and lifelong West Michigan resident.
He said he lives in Norton Shores with his wife and their two daughters, who attend Mona Shores Public Schools.

Reid said his campaign does not accept corporate dollars and that he would introduce legislation capping utility rate increases for three years and a bill freezing property taxes for five years after a home purchase by first-time buyers and seniors downsizing.

On health care, he said he would help advance the bipartisan Wholesale Prescription Drug Importation Act, end forced overtime for nurses outside declared emergencies, and regulate hospital consolidation.
